#!/bin/bash
# Runs as root under launchd. Routes only the PS5 (172.22.2.4) through a dedicated mihomo TUN;
# the Mac's own traffic, Clash Verge (7897) and the 4782 router are not touched.
set -u

BASE=/usr/local/ps5-clash-gateway
MIHOMO="$BASE/verge-mihomo"
IFACE=en0
GW_IP=172.22.1.4
TUN=utun233
ANCHOR=com.apple/ps5-clash
export SAFE_PATHS="/Users/stark/Library/Application Support/io.github.clash-verge-rev.clash-verge-rev/profiles"

pf_token=""
mihomo_pid=""

log() { echo "$(date '+%F %T') $*"; }

cleanup() {
  log "stopping"
  if [ -n "$mihomo_pid" ]; then
    kill "$mihomo_pid" 2>/dev/null
    wait "$mihomo_pid" 2>/dev/null
  fi
  pfctl -a "$ANCHOR" -F all >/dev/null 2>&1
  [ -n "$pf_token" ] && pfctl -X "$pf_token" >/dev/null 2>&1
  ifconfig "$IFACE" -alias "$GW_IP" 2>/dev/null
}

on_term() {
  cleanup
  exit 0
}
trap on_term TERM INT

ensure_net() {
  if ! ifconfig "$IFACE" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "inet $GW_IP "; then
    ifconfig "$IFACE" alias "$GW_IP" netmask 255.255.0.0 && log "alias $GW_IP added"
  fi
  if [ "$(sysctl -n net.inet.ip.forwarding)" != 1 ]; then
    sysctl -w net.inet.ip.forwarding=1 >/dev/null && log "ip forwarding enabled"
  fi
  if ifconfig "$TUN" >/dev/null 2>&1 && ! pfctl -a "$ANCHOR" -s rules 2>/dev/null | grep -q route-to; then
    pfctl -a "$ANCHOR" -f "$BASE/pf.conf" >/dev/null 2>&1 && log "pf anchor loaded"
  fi
}

if [ ! -x "$MIHOMO" ]; then
  log "missing $MIHOMO"
  sleep 60
  exit 1
fi

"$MIHOMO" -d "$BASE" -f "$BASE/config.yaml" >>"$BASE/mihomo.log" 2>&1 &
mihomo_pid=$!
pf_token=$(pfctl -E 2>&1 | awk '/Token/{print $3}')
log "started mihomo=$mihomo_pid pf_token=$pf_token"

while kill -0 "$mihomo_pid" 2>/dev/null; do
  ensure_net
  sleep 10 &
  wait $!
done

log "mihomo exited"
cleanup
exit 1
